name: What is the difference between porcelain tile and marble for a shower?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between porcelain tile and marble for a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain and ceramic tiles offer durability, low water absorption, and low maintenance, while natural marble delivers high-end luxury at the cost of higher upkeep. Marble requires periodic sealing and gentle, non-acidic cleaners because it absorbs moisture and stains more easily than glazed tile. Practical tradeoffs include material cost, slip resistance, and maintenance routines. Homeowners choosing natural stone gain an upscale appearance but must manage recurring sealing schedules. Large-format porcelain tiles minimize grout joints, whereas smaller mosaic tiles provide better natural traction on sloped shower floors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain is non-porous, highly durable, and low-maintenance. Marble offers premium beauty but requires routine sealing and careful cleaning to prevent stains.
